fields.name: isExternal
fields.label: Is External Article?
fields.description: Enable if this post is published on an external platform like Medium or Hackster.io.

fields.name: externalUrl
fields.label: External Article URL
fields.description: Direct link to the original article (e.g. https://medium.com/@...)

fields.name: platform
fields.label: Platform Name
fields.description: Name of the platform (e.g. Medium, Hackster.io, Dev.to, Substack)

fields.name: readingTime
fields.label: Reading Time
fields.description: Custom reading time (e.g. "5 min read" or "10"). If left blank, it will be automatically calculated.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
